description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Debug class, which compiles the {debug} template tag for the Smarty templating engine. It generates PHP code to display the Smarty debugging console.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Debug
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling the {debug} template tag in Smarty templates, enabling the display of the debugging console.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles PHP code that outputs the Smarty debugging console when the {debug} tag is used in templates.
